story.headline: From the field to code, from code to security
story.subtitle: Three chapters of a multidisciplinary journey — entrepreneur, developer, hotliner — augmented by AI and automation.

builder.title: The Builder
builder.body: Twenty years building, selling, integrating. From logistics agent to CEO of a patent-holding company, I've learned to turn an idea into a shipped product. Web, ERP, e-commerce, sales fieldwork: versatility as a method.

bridge.title: The Bridge
bridge.body: A deep technical reconversion: Full-Stack, BIG DATA, information security. Today hotliner and developer at ALOA — Python, Linux, WINDEV, PHP, SQL, IDS, Proxmox — at the heart of complex client infrastructures (EBP, SAGE, RDS, SaaS).

vision.title: The Vision
vision.body: AI-assisted vibe coding — Claude Code, Antigravity, Gemini — orchestrated with N8N and Supabase to automate what can be, and focus humans on what matters: decision, design, security. DevSecOps as the heading.
